blocks.text: 1980s pop star Tiffany made her New York theater debut in the new Off-Broadway production “Spandex the Musical,” which features a performance of her 1987 hit “I Think We’re Alone Now.” Tiffany took the spotlight during the staging of the show on Thursday, Sept. 17, with the 54-year-old American pop singer portraying the role of housewife Linda Gustafson who discovers aerobics and later competes in a national contest. “Spandex the Musical,” which also stars Sims Lamason, Catherine Bradley, and Nawaf Nooruddin, will run for 10 days at Off-Broadway’s Asylum NYC through Sept. 27.
